newsitem.title: TUNISIA: BIAT bank takes Tunis bourse up.
newsitem.headline: BIAT bank takes Tunis bourse up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed up by 0.34 percent in active trade boosted by BIAT bank, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 455.13 points, up from 453.59 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 16.02 million dinars against 595,344 dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 15.55 million dinars with 522,374 shares changing hands.
Most of the trade was on Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie at the unchanged price of 30 dinars with volume of 505,983 shares.
Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.8 dinar to 32 dinars. Chemical firm Alkimia rose 0.44 dinar to 40 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 0.18 dinar to 14.58 dinars.

Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was down 0.8 dinar to 8.7 dinars. Cola and beer bottler SFBT declined 0.5 dinar to 81 dinars. SFBT started on Tuesday distributing a 2.5 dinar dividend per share on its 1996 results. ($1=1.1062 dinar)
